items.title: nginx logrotate 保留份数
evidence: $ grep -n 'rotate' /etc/logrotate.d/nginx -> rc=0 | 4: rotate 14 10: prerotate 11: if [ -d /etc/logrotate.d/httpd-prerotate ]; then \ 12: run-parts /etc/logrotate.d/httpd-prerotate; \ 15: postrotate 16: invoke-rc.d nginx rotate >/dev/null 2>&1

$ ls -la /var/log/nginx | head -20 -> rc=0 | total 10820 drwxr-xr-x 2 root adm 4096 Oct 14 00:00 . drwxr-xr-x 11 root root 4096 Oct 1 00:00 .. -rw-r----- 1 www-data adm 12630 Oct 14 01:05 access.log -rw-r----- 1 www-data adm 7598205 Oct 13 23:59 access.log.1 -rw-r----- 1 www-data adm …
items.note: 将把 rotate 14 改成 rotate 2

items.note: 将在 music3 / h3 两个 location 内插入 access_log off;

items.title: vaproj-backend 日志降噪
evidence: $ cat /etc/systemd/system/vaproj-backend.service -> rc=0 | [Unit] Description=vaproj backend (uvicorn) After=network.target [Service] Type=simple User=root WorkingDirectory=/opt/vaproj/backend Environment=PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 ExecStart=/opt/vaproj/backend/.venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0…

$ grep -rn 'setup_logging' /opt/vaproj/backend/app/main.py /opt/vaproj/backend/app/core/logging.py -> rc=0 | /opt/vaproj/backend/app/main.py:14:from app.core.logging import get_logger, setup_logging /opt/vaproj/backend/app/main.py:39: setup_logging() /opt/vaproj/backend/app/core/logging.py:9:def setup_logging(level: str = "INFO") -> None:
items.note: 将写 drop-in LogLevelMax=warning 并 restart（app/core/logging.py 的 setup_logging(level='INFO') 读的是硬编码默认值、不认环境变量，所以走 journald 侧 LogLevelMax=warning（日志仍写 stdout，只是不进 journal））
